scope.goal: M4/U10 Intel macOS architecture dependency candidate for the fixed cryptography==50.0.1 closure
scope.source_scope: Build only the cryptography 50.0.1 Intel wheel from its exact official sdist; do not change package pins, locks, canonical dependency-prep evidence, progress/state files, application bundle, M1 core, COMSOL installation, license, or system toolchain.

upstream_support.upstream_intel_support: UNSUPPORTED_BY_UPSTREAM; PyCA changelog says macOS x86_64 support/wheels were removed beginning with 49.0.0. This wheel is project-derived and does not restore upstream support.

official_sources.fact: 49.0.0 removed macOS x86_64 support and stopped publishing Intel wheels.
Official 50.0.1 source distribution is available; no macOS x86_64 wheel is published.
Documents source builds with Rust and private/static OpenSSL; it does not establish upstream Intel support.
PyCA 50.0.2's official platform wheels use OpenSSL 4.0.3; this project build independently compiles the pinned 50.0.1 source against that OpenSSL release.
